compiled_state.title: Build the fail-closed review-gate summary check + shared ticket-exemption helper
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
As a maintainer, I want a single always-runs, fail-closed `review-gate` summary check on every base==main PR so that the conjunction of independently-skippable required checks is replaced by one gate that cannot report success without per-SHA review coverage.

Plan refs: A-4.5; §2.6 (REDESIGN); §2.9/§2.10 (shared exemption helper). THE ARCHITECTURAL CORE. Ship in warn/advisory first and shadow-observe on live PR2 traffic.

DONE DEFINITION:
- DD1: a single script `review-gate` (NOT a needs/if:failure() aggregation — that greens on a skipped upstream) runs on every base==main PR with no code_changed skip. (SC1)
- DD2: it fails-closed unless every SHA in origin/main..head is proven reviewed by the per-SHA review-coverage-invariant, EXCEPT SHAs whose diff is entirely within an EXEMPT path. The exemption is diff-scoped tree evidence ONLY (git diff-tree non-empty AND every entry under an exempt prefix) — never a trailer/marker (v4 fabricated-trailer lesson); empty file list = NOT exempt. (SC1/SC4)
- DD3: ONE shared helper `rc_diff_is_exempt_only <sha>` (in review-coverage-lib.sh, sourced by all three consumers) computes the exemption. It is wired into review-coverage-invariant.sh, verify-session-provenance.sh, AND fp-recovery-audit-sweep.sh (the last has no clean-merge scaffolding today — build it). Each consumer honors its own error posture; the predicate is identical. (SC4)
- DD3a (CONFIG-DRIVEN EXEMPT SET — host-inheritable): the exempt prefixes are NOT hardcoded. They are:
    (i) the event-sourced ticket store (.tickets-tracker tree), and
    (ii) the configured VERSION FILE — read from dso config key `version.file_path` via read-config.sh (the same key bump-version.sh uses; supports .json/.toml/plaintext). A commit whose diff is entirely the version file is exempt.
  Because the version path comes from config, HOST PROJECTS inherit this behavior with their OWN version file (pyproject.toml, package.json, plaintext VERSION, etc.) — no dso-specific hardcoding. When `version.file_path` is unset, only the ticket-store exemption applies.
  RATIONALE: a version bump (or a rebase-resolved version-conflict commit) is an inert mechanical change; without this exemption an un-provenanced version-only commit reaching the staged branch would trip the per-SHA coverage walk and trigger an llm-review re-review (or fail-close), re-introducing review churn for a non-reviewable change. Mixed version+code in one commit is NOT exempt (diff-scoped — prevents laundering code through a version bump).
- DD4: it runs the dangling-references check inline (same script) so it cannot independently skip-to-success, and replaces the no-op merge-pipeline-checks umbrella as the always-runs gate. (SC1)
- DD5: it fail-closes on precondition with bounded retry (story 2 ledger) and reconciles with assert-review-liveness.sh (does NOT re-implement liveness's classification cross-check; complementary, boundary documented). (SC1)
- DD6: a single shared-fixture EQUIVALENCE TEST asserts all three exemption consumers return identical exempt/not-exempt verdicts (the trailer-shortcut survived in one path after removal from another — prevent the same divergence).
- DD7: coordinate with story 6 (allowlist tightening) so the PR-level allowlist's version-file handling uses the SAME config-driven `version.file_path` (remove the hardcoded `**/.claude-plugin/plugin.json` allowlist entry) — the per-SHA exemption (this story) and the PR-level allowlist must agree on what "version file" means, sourced from one config key.

LIVE VERIFICATION + EXPERIMENTS (warn mode):
- E2: allowlisted-only PR2 with un-reviewed content -> review-gate would BLOCK (logs FAIL in warn).
- E3: confirm merge-pipeline-checks no-ops on staged-* head and review-gate is the real always-runs gate.
- E8: populated staged-* merge-commit: clean merge -> exempt (no false wedge); evil merge (manual edit in merge commit) -> RED.
- E14/E15 across all three consumers: ticket-only -> exempt; version-file-only -> exempt; mixed exempt+code -> NOT exempt (no launder); clean merge -> exempt. Identical verdicts.
- E-version (NEW): a version-file-only commit that did NOT ride a sub-PR (e.g. a rebase-resolved or staged-level bump) -> PR2 does NOT trigger llm-review/coverage against it; a commit mixing a version bump with a code change -> NOT exempt (re-reviewed). Run with both the dso version.file_path (plugin.json) and a simulated host config (e.g. pyproject.toml) to prove host-inheritance.
- E13: confirm a skipped upstream does NOT green the gate (single-script property).
- Shadow-observe several real PR2 promotions in warn mode; review-gate's warn verdict must match the actual outcome with zero false BLOCKs.

COURSE-CORRECTION TRIGGER: if review-gate in warn mode would FALSE-BLOCK any legitimate PR2 (clean, fully-reviewed, ticket-only, or version-only), STOP and fix before story 6/7 — a false-wedge under enforce blocks the team. If the three consumers ever disagree on an exemption verdict, STOP (launder/wedge risk).

Maps to SC1, SC4. DEPENDS ON stories 1 (fail-closed), 2 (ledger), 4 (dangling matcher).

comments.body: Added config-driven version-file exemption (DD3a + DD7 + E-version): the shared exemption helper rc_diff_is_exempt_only reads version.file_path from dso config (host-inheritable; supports .json/.toml/plaintext), exempting version-file-only commits from per-SHA coverage so an un-provenanced version bump or rebase-resolved version-conflict commit cannot trigger llm-review re-review. Diff-scoped (mixed version+code NOT exempt). Sourced from one config key shared with the story-6 allowlist.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: DD8 (prerequisite — fixes bug 4ba5): correct the net-end-state diff computation in build-integration-diff.sh / llm-review-dispatch-or-skip.sh for MERGE COMMITS. Today a conflict-resolution merge commit whose real delta is the version field computes 0 touched files, so the 'empty net diff on unprovenanced range -> fail-closed' contract hard-blocks the PR (4ba5). This is LOAD-BEARING for DD2/DD3a: the version-file exemption checks 'diff entirely within version.file_path', and the I-1 'empty file list = NOT exempt' guard would be FALSELY tripped by the same mis-computation -> the exemption cannot fire until the merge-commit net-diff is correct. Fix: net-end-state diff for a merge commit must report the files its conflict resolution actually changed vs main (the version line), so (a) a version-only resolution is correctly exempt, and (b) a genuinely-empty diff is distinguishable from a mis-computed-empty one. Reuse the design's rebase-not-merge path to AVOID version merge commits where possible, but the diff computation must still be correct for any other unprovenanced merge commit. Add a regression test reproducing 4ba5 (merge commit resolving a version conflict -> non-empty net diff = version file only -> exempt, not blocked).

comments.body: Version-bump research (V1+V-workflow, validated live): a separate version-bump-on-merge GitHub Action keeps the version OFF feature branches (eliminates the conflict class). Net for S5: KEEP the version.file_path diff-scoped exemption (DD3a) as enforcement option B (version-only PR rides the process, exempt from coverage); the L6 semver-max rebase resolver is DROPPED (no longer needed). See docs/handoff/resilience-hardening-plan.md §9.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: AMENDMENT (KEEP version-bump decision, 2026-06-03): DD3a's version-file coverage exemption (rc_diff_is_exempt_only, the version.file_path arm) is REMOVED. Under KEEP (resilience-hardening-plan SS9.5/SS9.6, owned by story 3ebb-fa93-f980-40de DD2) the version bump rides PR1's review-sub-pr (plugin.json allowlisted -> skip-to-success) and is COVERED per-SHA like any commit -- no separate coverage exemption needed. Retain ONLY the ticket-store exemption (rc_diff_is_tickets_only). Drop the E-version test case (no orphan version SHA exists under KEEP -- the bump always rides PR1). DD7 reduces to keeping plugin.json in the review-gate ALLOWLIST (review-sub-pr skip); the coverage-invariant version exemption is gone. This story now depends_on 3ebb (DD1 tristate + DD2 KEEP).
